## Biography

Usman Ahmed is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Civil & Environmental
Engineering at [University Name], where he directs the Mobility Systems Lab. His research
focuses on traffic operations, transportation safety analytics, and the integration of
connected and automated vehicle (CAV) technologies into real-world transportation
networks. His work has been supported by [Funding Agencies, e.g., NSF, USDOT, State DOT]
and published in leading journals including *Transportation Research Part C*, *Accident
Analysis & Prevention*, and *Journal of Transportation Engineering, Part A*.

Prior to [University Name], he was a postdoctoral researcher at [Institution], and he
completed his Ph.D. in Civil Engineering at [Ph.D. Institution] in [Year], advised by
[Advisor Name]. He also holds an M.S. in Transportation Engineering from
[M.S. Institution] and a B.S. in Civil Engineering from [B.S. Institution].

## Research Interests

- Traffic flow theory, control, and simulation
- Transportation safety analytics and crash prediction
- Connected and automated vehicle (CAV) systems
- Public transit accessibility and equity
- Freight systems and urban logistics
- Applied machine learning for mobility data
